name: Eustress Engine
description: Eustress is a source-available simulation and data platform built in Rust; it also builds games and interactive worlds. It offers performance, memory safety and developer experience, and it stays free forever.

offers.description: Free forever. Premium subscriptions available for enhanced features.

products.name: Eustress Engine
products.description: Simulation and creation suite. Build 3D worlds, script behavior and gameplay logic with Soul, design UI, and publish to multiple platforms, all from one tool.

products.name: Eustress Player
products.description: Discover and play thousands of community-created simulations. Jump into games instantly through Steam, connect with friends, and explore endless creativity.
